plain: Wii channel menu: one row of equal buttons with a written MORE; its More page no longer breaks words like 'Achievements' across two lines.
The Arcade menu pointer and the Pocket ribbon START label now sit exactly in the middle of their buttons.
Side menu: every button and the Save sync line now fit in the drawer on the KONKR instead of being cut at the bottom; the Bar layout's category arrows are drawn centred.

Development moved to the cloud: it now builds, tests and pushes without your PC. The emulator test, which crashed every time, now stays up. Library's L2 / R2 hints are centred and the Side menu's sync line is full touch size again.
Fixed the automatic test run running out of memory (it was stopped by the watchdog on some pushes); the heaviest test groups now run in their own fresh process. CI has been green since.
Emulator test: the QA scripts now wait until the app has written its screen description instead of reading half-written files; the Game shelf check passed on the emulator for the first time.
Emulator test records more evidence when a first button press seems to do nothing, so real app problems can be told apart from test timing.
Emulator test reads very long screen descriptions correctly (it missed buttons on long lines before), which caused false 'no Details button' failures.
The symbol-centring checker measures button symbols inside the button's real outline, so a busy background can no longer make a centred symbol look off-centre.
Added this status dashboard, with counts taken from the evidence files and all hardware checks batched into one PC session.

The dashboard now opens with a plain-English owner summary and a release tracker: v0.6.73's fixes, which are verified, which gates are left and why it cannot ship yet - all worked out from the evidence files, not typed by hand.

Four fix options are written up for your pick; the Thor check needs you to start the game yourself while I only read.
